name: pressure_plate
space: Blender coords: +Z up, front -Y, the floor is z = 0 with the origin under the plate's centre. glTF/Godot: (x, z, -y). The plate slides along its bone's local Y (value in metres; negative = pressed).

cutout_m.note: the tray sits in this cut-out, its rim and tread crowns flush with ground when unpressed; pressing moves downward

materials_note: map-generic finish in Tensor's materials (off-white and grey paint, matte black, stainless steel): no team colours
usage: a step-on switch: play press when the first player (or anything heavy) steps on the plate and release when the last one steps off. The plate sinks 5 cm; the switch clicks at the bottom of press, and the game acts on it, for example toggling a barricade (raise / lower).
